description: Mark a task done; advances recurrence if applicable. Set with_children:true to also complete every incomplete inline subtask (the parent plus all descendants); already-done subtasks are left untouched. Set dry_run:true to preview the result (e.g. next_instance) without writing. For a recurring task, next_instance is the new occurrence's date and next_instance_id its fresh stable id (null when the task has no id, or on a dry run); the completed task keeps its own id, so dependsOn references to it are satisfied. The result's was_dependency_blocked flags a task completed while a dependsOn target was still OPEN (blocking_tasks lists them) — informational, the completion is never refused; check it and surface/undo if the block was unintended. A dependsOn target naming no task does not block; warnings name it instead. When onCompletion deleted the task, warnings also name any dependsOn reference elsewhere left pointing at it (it no longer blocks; doctor lists it). An onCompletion archive goes to the archive folder (task files) or file (inline tasks) of the space the task belongs to when that space keeps its own storage settings; pass space to name one, and warnings say when the task's spaces disagree and the vault-wide archive was used.

dry_run.description:
When true, PREVIEW the completion without mutating: nothing is
written to disk, but the result still reports what WOULD happen
(e.g. `next_instance` for a recurring task). Useful to inspect a
`with_children:true` cascade before committing it.

space.description:
Archive with this saved space's (id or name, as `list_spaces`
reports it) archive folder or file rather than the one the task's
own spaces select. Applies when this call fires an onCompletion
archive. An unknown space is refused.

with_children.description:
When true, also complete the task's inline subtasks: the parent
plus every incomplete inline descendant is flipped to done in one
write (already-done descendants are left untouched). Parent
recurrence and onCompletion still fire.

name: complete_task
